reviews.title: Sizing for shorter people non existent
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I gave a 4/5 not because it didn't deserve a 5,which it did. I only wish Levi as well as other Jean manufacturers would make shorter lengths for shorter people. I know it's an economic thing and the demand isn't there but that's my 2 cents.

reviews.title: Spandex is horrible
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Spandex is horrible in all of its Levi jeans it stretches out the Jean material and they start feeling loose and baggy in just hours. Levi needs to go back to 100 cotton jeans now they add plastics in their jeans now horrible quality jeans

reviews.title: tag issue
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] You sent me the product with the security tag, now I have a product that I cant use

reviews.title: They felt suffocating.
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Thought they'd fit like 520 Slouch Skinny, but they didn't.

reviews.title: Levi's... What happened?
reviews.review_text: I have a couple of ten year old pairs of 511s that are very well cut. Truly skinny jeans, that were 100% cotton. They are getting a bit worn, so I ordered the same size in both 511 and 510. Both are like wearing relaxed jeans, so why did they even bother to add the stretchy synthetic fabric to them? I sent the 511s back. Wish I had with the 510s. Levi's, you've lost the clue. Sad and shameful.

reviews.title: not Exactly my size
reviews.review_text: i v been shopping with Levis for a long time and i had problems with size and fittings before i always wear 34/32 this jeans is tight with my waist and short in length i already have few skinny jeans from Levis and they all have different fittings issues i had to return some of them

reviews.title: I just bought non-levi's for the first time in 13 years
reviews.review_text: I haven't owned a pair of non-levi's since I was about 10. These jeans made me buy black skinny jeans elsewhere. The quality on these competitor jeans isn't what the quality on these used to be, but at least the fit is right. These have a bad mom fit and are a poor quality material. Why isn't anyone reading these reviews?

reviews.title: what happened
reviews.review_text: I just ordered a pair of these jeans after having ordered several over the years and the fit is now terrible. They used to be the most perfect fit and now they sit so high it is comical. Please go back to the old fit as now I have to return my order and wont order again until I receive an e-mail letting me know that they are back to how they were.

reviews.title: This is probably the last time ordered
reviews.review_text: I ordered a pair in May 2015 and they have already pretty much are done with i had to repair tears that formed in the inner leg area of the pants were they have always done this but not this quick this was within 5 monthes. Ah i rememeber the days when the 510 were called Super Skinnys and actually lasted at least 2 yrs with hard use. These are poor QC even if you buy together they all will usually fit diffrently. If these that i just ordered are the same quality i will definatly be looking for other options.

reviews.title: What??
reviews.review_text: I've ordered a few pairs at once, different washes. Had to sell all of them to my friends. This NEW FIT is the worst thing that can ever happen to the good old "510 Super Skinny". The only thing that really bothers me is that you missinform your customers: you say they're SKINNY from hip to ankle and LOW WAISTED. THEY'RE NOT SKINNY, COMPARED TO THE OLD 510 JEANS! THE WAIST IS SUPER HIGH! THEY DON'T EXPRESS COOLNESS. THEY DON'T MAKE YOUR LEGS LOOK GOOD. THEY SAG! COMPARED TO THE 2007-2012 FIT, THIS NEW FIT IS A JOKE! The pictures are also misleading.

reviews.title: Different cut and different material
reviews.review_text: At some point, Levi's entirely changed the cut and material used for the 510. They now fit like 511's, but with a "mom jeans" style extended crotch. They also changed the denim to a more canvas style material that is awful. Not sure why they did this, but it's a serious bummer.

reviews.title: Why would you ruin a good thing?
reviews.review_text: You used to make the perfect black skinny jean. I could buy them online and always know what I was going to get. I ordered a pair a few weeks ago and they are a completely different fit and material. The crotch hangs an extra 2 inches if you wear them at your waist ( or you can pull them up an extra 2 Inches and wear them as mom jeans). Plus the material is all stretchy and cheap feeling. Bring back the old fit. PLEASE.

reviews.title: I am saddened
reviews.review_text: These used to be my go to for at least 8+ yrs and have been wonderful but this last 2 pairs (Jet) I ordered and even the pair that i bought before these are not the same as before. These that i ordered on the same order were as I ordered 2 different pairs of styles one was kinda snug but not like originally and the other felt as the straight cut or the old 511 Skinny's but still baggier. Already just 6 months later they are already wearing down and one now has holes in the inner leg and these haven't been used on a bicycle this time around i used to abuse these jeans a lot more and they would still last 1.5-2yrs or longer. Shame guess I'll have to look elsewhere now :(

reviews.title: Not the same
reviews.review_text: I've been wearing 510's for the last 8 years and I am very disappointed to say that these are NOT the same jeans that I fell in love with. These seem more like 511's that couldn't pass the QA tests, so they were rebranded 510's. I'm so disappointed with these new "510's" and unfortunately I'm going to have to look elsewhere for something that resembles the old "super skinny" fit. 1/10 would not recommend if you're looking for an actually skinny jean.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.review_text: I've worn 510s and 511s for a long time, and I've always loved them. But I just bought a new pair of 510s, and they're terrible. As others have mentioned, the crotch sits way too low, and the quality of the denim is extremely poor. These jeans are too stretchy, and they do not fit comfortably against the leg. Instead, they sag. The old 510s were fantastic, but these stretch denim versions are not worth it. I'll not buy these again until Levis goes back to the old 510s

reviews.title: Jet Color Has Strange Fit
reviews.review_text: I ordered a bunch of 510's at once and the Jet color definitely has something wrong with the fit for this batch. They are tight up top and very tight and the knee, but the cut from the knee down is boxy and a little strange. Not the worst pants ever, but not as sleek as a normal 510. I do hope Levi's will fix this in future versions of the black 510. The Coral, Winetasting and Westside colors all have a more traditional 510 cut.

reviews.title: Bummer Levi's
reviews.review_text: I've worn EXCLUSIVELY the 510 Skinny Fit (jet) Jeans for years now. I loved them- note the shift to past tense. I too have noticed the gradual decline in the quality of these jeans. Just as everyone is saying here: the waist is higher, the crotch lower, the ankle doesn't taper to a skinny fit let alone a super skinny fit- which I think this inconsistency between one pair to the next bothers me the most. I'd also agree the overall hand of the denim has gotten pretty bad. The color of the denim is pretty whack as well- definitely not Jet Black throughout- the reverse side of the denim has a yellow tint, which looks pretty terrible if you like to cuff your jeans. All these inconsistencies in one pair of 510's to the next has completely exhausted me. Buying a pair of 510's has become a tiresome hunt where I have in the past tried on four pairs of the same size just to try and figure out which one wasn't the worst fit, but I'm done doing that. I've concluded they are all pretty bad. Bummer Levi's.

reviews.title: Not the same 510 at all...
reviews.review_text: Not the same as they use to be. These do not fit anywhere close to my previous pairs of 510's. Not only do they sit higher up on the waist, but they also don't fit as snuggly on the legs as even an older pair of 511's I have. Very disappointed. I was excited to see my favorite cut back again in my size, but now I'm back to having to shop elsewhere.

reviews.title: Used to love 510 now waist sits high, crotch sits low
reviews.review_text: These jeans used to be perfect on the waist, legs and crotch... They are now terrible on the waist and crotch. The waist sits way to high and is too big, the crotch used to be great but now sits way too low. The fit on the legs is ok. Please go back to your old pattern. I wear them but I'm never thrilled and think Other mall brands have now surpassed them with fit and perhaps material quality as well.

reviews.title: Very Disappointed
reviews.review_text: I was very disappointed upon the arrival of my order. The 510's had been my favorite style of any brand of jeans for years. When I tried these on after they arrived, it was very clear to me that they changed the cut and style of them from even just a year ago. They are hardly skinny and they sit much higher on the weist. It's almost like they just threw a 510 tag on 511's.

reviews.title: this used to be the only jeans i wore
reviews.review_text: I have had so many of these jeans I was so disappointed that they changed the cut. I buy my jeans in bulk because I go through them so fast and had to return the last 3 pair that I bought. They DO NOT fit below the waist, they are soccer mom jeans now or something Olivia Newton-John would wear. I bought a pair of 511's but its not the same. I had to leave the brand to find jeans that worked for me for the first time in years. Let me know when you fix the issue, Levi has been one of the few brands of anything I am loyal to.

reviews.title: I miss the old 510s
reviews.review_text: Been wearing these jeans ever since I can remember and this is the first time that I have been really disappointed... They have become cheap light weight stretchy weird denim that sags in the crotch and makes you look like you are wearing a diaper. I'm not sure what happened to the good ole Levi quality but I'm pretty upset

reviews.title: TOO BAGGY, NOT THE SAME QUALITY FIT
reviews.review_text: SORRY THIS QUALITY HAS GONE OUT OF STYLE I'm aware that whenever I click on this category for 510's it say Skinny instead of Super Skinny, was this change necessary? I didn't order a 514 or a 511 I ordered a tight fitting jeans from a Quality brand who disappointed me with their style update from perfectly fitting 510's to this baggy square jeans.NOT BUYING ANYTHING UNTIL PRODUCTS FIT HOW THEY USED TO ORIGINALLY.

reviews.title: Not true 510s...
reviews.review_text: LEVI - listen to the many customer reviews and bring back the old 510 jet cut! I am so disappointed with the recent changes to the fit of these jeans. When I ordered a new pair I thought I was mistakenly given 511s. I returned them online, bought another pair in-store, and still the same problem. As other reviewers have complained: the crotch is an extra 1" long, waist is high, cheap / stretchy fabric, practically bootcut leg opening... Not what you expect from 510s. Don't ruin a good thing. Bring back the good old 510 jet jeans.

reviews.title: Just Horrible
reviews.review_text: These jeans use to be the perfect jeans until they made it high wasted, now everytime I walk it makes a noise. Just horrible. I thought levis was dependable but this just tells you they make poor jeans and they don't listen to their customers cause their customers has been telling them that they're bad but they don't change it back. Just awful. I'm a loyal customer but I think its time to go somewhere else.

reviews.title: Buy 511's + Taper them from the thigh down
reviews.review_text: These jeans are awful. The leg opening is wide, the thighs are incredibly tight, and the crotch drops low. 511's however still feel pretty good in the waist, crotch and thighs. I just bought a couple pairs and took them to a tailor and had her slim them into what the old 510's were. Sure it is an annoying extra step, but it worked.

reviews.title: Not So Skinny
reviews.review_text: These appear to be Levi's skinniest model, which is pretty shocking. They're just not skinny. They're relatively close down to just above the knee but from there down they just aren't. At all. I'm 5'9", 170 lbs., so I'm not a toothpick. I don't need these to fit like stretch pants or cut off my circulation, but there shouldn't be a lot of material floating around that you can just grab, which is the case the full length of these jeans. The leg opening should be awfully close to my leg but it's not even pretending. I could literally fit the leg opening easily over cowboy boots, if I were inclined to wear cowboy boots, which I am not. I can hold a full 2" flap from the leg opening to the calf - that's not a skinny fit by any definition. They don't look tapered, they look boxy. My wife walked in while I was trying them on and she literally said, "Are those Husky Cut or what?". I want to wear Levi's because I like the quality, but I don't think I can deal with these. I bought two pair and they're both the same. They're just bad. I guess I'll have to find some generic brand that understands, as Levi's did at one time, how skinny jeans are supposed to fit.

reviews.title: Baffled by New Fit; Levis Missed the Mark
reviews.review_text: I agree with the others who believe Levis messed up with the new fit. Seriously, what were they thinking? The crotch sits way too low, so it feels like you're "sagging" your pants even if you're wearing them where they naturally fall on your waist. The openings are not tapered enough and feel weird. After a few washes, I've found that the legs shrink in length, so you'll be pulling the leg bottoms down every time you stand up. I've owned a couple pairs of these revised 510s and will not be buying another unless Levis listens to the complaints. They tried to go too middle of the road and failed. I loved the old "super skinny" fit, never had a problem with them shrinking, and the material felt better.

reviews.title: 510 became old 511
reviews.review_text: What happened Levi's? The 510 super skinny were my go to jeans of choice for years now. Unfortunately it looks like the one pair I have left is the last i'll own. I didn't want to believe it just from the pictures, but you can tell that the new 510 jeans are the old 511 cut, and they fazed out the good old 510 completely. Until you bring back the 510 of past seasons I can't wear these. there was a reason I bought 510 and not 511, but now I have no choice but to look elsewhere for a skinny jean. (PS) take down the old reviews under 510, they don't apply anymore with this change in cut.

reviews.title: Very disappointing..
reviews.review_text: The apparently updated cut of these 510s are not the 510s I fell in love with and have owned at least six previous pairs of. The fit now has a dropped-crotched and a wider (almost flared) leg opening. The quality of the material also seems to have been degraded -- the material felt itchy on my legs, even after washing (which has never happened before with these) and they are uncomfortable to wear for extended periods of time. I would not buy again.

reviews.title: 510 Jet fit has changed for the worse
reviews.review_text: The recent negative reviews are correct. The new 510s fit nothing like their older counterparts. I have had multiple pairs of the 510 Jet over the past 5 pairs, and this new pair is by far the least skinny fitting. The rise is very high, therefore they look silly if you wear them low on your waist do too the long crotch. The leg opening below the knee is too loose to be considered skinny, as it is the same as my 511s of the same size. The only positive I can give is that the actual denim material is nice and thick, and the seams are sewn straight. Overall, I am very disappointed and will need to find a new pair of black skinnies.

reviews.title: Native Cali
reviews.review_text: Not able to try on in stores currently I had hoped they fit like other 510's. They're a bit longer and don't taper at the bottom as I'd like. Look more like a straight leg then a skinny.

reviews.title: Poor quality but fits well.
reviews.review_text: Pants fit true to size but each pair I buy the quality dips. Few months a pocket ripped and a few months after that my pants ripped in the crotch area. This pair didn't last NEARLY as long as the pair before. So buy two. You'll need it.

reviews.title: Not the same 510's you're thinking of.
reviews.review_text: These fit like 511's. Loose in the thighs, and calves, rougher cheap feeling denim If you're looking for proper 510 skinny jeans (smooth denim), these aren't it. Levi's, you've lost your touch.

reviews.title: Why is the crotch so high..?
reviews.review_text: I really like the fit of these, I wish they were skinnier for sure. But the main issue is the waist to crotch length its HUGE. i have to bring it past my belly button if i don't want to look like I am sagging my pants.

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY
reviews.review_text: They made the jean a lot looser in fit. It sure does not have the snug they used to have. Very disappointed in the 510's. Time to start to look for a new brand.

reviews.title: New cut is terrible
reviews.review_text: So upset with this new cut. I have 8 pairs of old cut. Walked in and bought new pair off the shelf only to discover this terrible new cut. I'm changing brands if u don't bring back the old cut. Very unhappy!

reviews.title: CROTCH RIPS EVERY 2 MONTHS
reviews.review_text: 0 STARS!!! I HAVE TO BUY A NEW PAIR OF THESE EVERY 2 MONTHS BECAUSE THEY RIP IN THE CROTCH I DEMAND THREE NEW PAIR IN RETURN FOR ALL MY RIPPED PANTS LAYING AROUND THAT I CAN NO LONGER WHAT.

reviews.title: Fit just like 511's
reviews.review_text: I used to wear to 511's but switched to skinny jeans and decided to get 510's and when i got them in they fit like 511's even if not baggier. Very disappointing

reviews.title: BAGGY
reviews.review_text: My second pair of RIGID DRAGON. The one that I've bought 2 years ago was super cool. This one is baggy, has a dropped crotch and the leg opening is wide. What is wrong with this fit? The old 510 fit was great! Why did you change it?

reviews.title: Great Levi's quality but lacking...
reviews.review_text: While the quality of denim was what i have come to expect from levi"s (which is alot) Was right on point i found that for me personally with my somewhat longer torso these jeans just didnt work out perhaps if youre a shorter guy hoping to find jeans that sit around belly button level then these might work out well for you but for me an extra 2 or more inches on the rise and i could have kept them holding out for Levi to release a true high rise skinny/slim jeans for men someday

reviews.title: Better quality control needed. These are slim fit and sometimes that may be generous.
reviews.review_text: Seven pairs of Levi 510's in Jet later, and I now know that quality control is almost absent from this particular fit. They are generally okay around the waist, but the leg is not actually skinny on most of them. These do not have a consistent fit. I have pairs in 32x34 that are WAY skinnier than the ones in 30x30. How? Probably because quality control is lacking. I know I am far from the first person to complain about this.

reviews.title: Strange fitting
reviews.review_text: I have purchased few 510's, Levi keeps on changing the fit of these. Secondly, the current fit available hangs too low in the crotch at least 1.5 inches extra. This restricts your movement which is not expected from a jean because you wear jean to move freely. If you pull the jeans up and wear a tighter belt, it doesn't look smart at all. I would say, only a super skinny guy should wear these.

reviews.title: Why did Levi's change the fit?!
reviews.review_text: I recently purchased these jeans in a Levi's store and was GREATLY disappointed. I'm 5'6" 140-145lbs. with and athletic/muscular build and typically wear my 510s a size 30x32. As others have noted the color is misleading in the photo. The wash is a bit darker than it appears online in person. Upon trying the new fit/style on in the store I went doen 2 sizes in the waist while my length remained the same. However after taking the jeans home and wearing/walking around in them a bit longer, I noticed that the crotch sags. I measured it and the seam (zipper to where the stitching meets) is 2" larger than normal which makes for a awkward fit. Also the material feels a bit thin and less durable. I really hope they go back to the measurements, materials, and sizing previously used. Levi's typically does such great work. It's unfortunate they changed. I'm hoping a tailor can make the necessary adjustments to the crotch in the jeans to fix the overall fit.

reviews.title: No longer skinny
reviews.review_text: I've had multiple pairs of 510's over the years (probably about 15 pairs or so), and the latest cut is absolutely abysmal. The long crotch, high cut and looser fit no longer fit my body type, and as such I'll not buy another pair again. Why change the cut of a classic jean, Levis? LEAVE IT ALONE - IT WAS JUST FINE!

reviews.title: Recut for the worse.
reviews.review_text: Don't expect these 510's to fit like the 510's of years past. Levi has changed the 510's fit, the fit is far looser than it used to be, the fit is now more liken to slim fit, NOT SKINNY! And unfortunately waist rise is 2 inches higher, changing where they sit on the waist. I am disappointed. Levi, PLEASE bring back the previous cut.

reviews.title: Fit is not what it should be.
reviews.review_text: I gotta agree with people about the long rise. It's super ridiculous. I recently switched from 511s because I wanted a tighter taper at the ankle. The only thing that is really any skinnier is the thighs and its not by much. I measured the leg opening and it is exactly the same on my 511s and 510s, all size 32x30. What is the point of having a skinny fit and a slim fit if they have almost exactly the same measurements? I still like and wear them but I am looking for some skinnier skinny jeans. Been wearing Levi's forever but I'm gonna be switching it up. Lower the rise and tighten the ankle!!!

reviews.title: New material, less comfort.
reviews.review_text: These 510s are not as well made as the jet black 510's from last year. They lack some of the embellishments found in the last design (ex: there are no black inner pockets and no black buttons). They are also not made from the same material. The new material has a slightly different look to it (different dye?) and is not as comfortable/soft as the old jet 510s. I prefer the previous design and would suggest that levis make these jeans as well as they used to. What was a great pair of jeans is now just a decent one.

reviews.title: New fit - Rise WAY to high, and now slim, not skinny.
reviews.review_text: I bought these pants over and over again, and never considered another brand or fit. But now, the fit is totally different. Really wish they would go back to the lower rise, and tighter leg...\ Now has a high rise (to my belly button) and is not as skinny. Sorry to say I was a Levis Guy, and now I have to look for something new...

reviews.title: Disappointment concurred
reviews.review_text: These jeans are a monstrosity! They fit nothing like the 510s that Levi's were making 2 years ago and now I'll have to return them. They have no stretch and the leg opening is much wider than it used to be. Levi's bring back the old 510s in Rocky Point Grey! They're my only pair of jeans and falling apart. These new ones are unacceptable!

reviews.title: Misleading Photo
reviews.review_text: I purchased the "Lionsmaine- Black" color, due to the seemingly charcoal shade of black displayed in the photo. However once they arrived, the jeans were very washed out, so light that I question if the pair I recieved were the same pair displayed in the picture. Sure enough, upon further inspection, the jeans I recieved have a black lining and black tag, unlike the ones displayed in the picture of the guy standing backwards, therefore confirming my suspicion that these jeans were in fact not the jeans I believed I was ordering. I will be returning so I did not try them for fit. In conclusion, these are light grey jeans.

reviews.title: No 36?
reviews.review_text: Kind of expensive and no 36 length..... Levi's have lost their way

reviews.title: They fit weird
reviews.review_text: They are tight where you don't want them to be tight and loose where you don't want them to be loose

reviews.title: very frustrating
reviews.review_text: if you change them back to what i'm wearing right now i would buy ten pairs , someone help me find the old ones

reviews.title: high waist/ high rise; made for soccer moms! :( :(
reviews.review_text: I ordered three pairs only to find that the updated 510s have an exceptionally high waist (11" on a 30x30 - see attached image), 7" at the knee and 6.75" at the leg opening. these are no longer the skinny jeans I've bought for years and loved.

reviews.title: DROPPED CROTCH, EXTRA HIGH WAIST, NOT SKINNY, BOOTCUT LEG OPENING
reviews.review_text: These jeans are not skinny. They run big and the inseam is 1 inch shorter. The waist is SUPER HIGH and the leg opening is like a bootcut. The fabric feels cheap. The old 510 Jet were fantastic.

reviews.title: Aweful fit, way too tight
reviews.review_text: These jeans were way too tight. I have never wrote a review over anything in my life before because I never deemed it to be neccesary but this is absolutely preposterous. These jeans fit way too tight. I am 5'10 & weigh about 137 pounds & I ordered a 30'32 pair. What a joke more like a 28'32. I order all my jeans from Levi's in a 30'30 & 30'32 & the fit on these were just terribly off. I couldn't even raise my knee let alone squat or crouch & the jeans were very uncomfortable as well. This is a product that Levi's needs to refine or just trash completely. I love Levi's but this "Rigid Dragon," pair is truly & very utterly "Rigid."

reviews.title: Runs small
reviews.review_text: I bought a pair of these roughly one year ago and they definitely fit smaller than my other 510s. A little too small. Unfortunately they haven't stretched much either. I recently bought another pair that were one size larger. While the waist fit, the rest of the jeans fit more like a 511 due to sizing up. I'd avoid these all together if you want them to fit like a true 510.

reviews.title: The WORST skinny jeans.
reviews.review_text: I went into this thinking i was making a smart decision. I mean it said SUPER SKINNY and the pictures of them looked ok. Boy was i wrong. 1st off they are huge and they are not even skinny. The thing is they had the ex girlfriend jeans which were actual skinny jeans, but they got of that style of jean.

reviews.title: Just not the same Levi Quality
reviews.review_text: The jeans overall feel cheap. Not the levi's quality I have loved over the years. The stretchy fabric is nice and comfortable but doesn't help the look. The cuff especially is where I have a problem. It's too wide. It gets wide at the very bottom and you can't really roll it up at all because there's so much material it gets bulky. Levi's never used to be like this. I also wish they sold all the colors without the stretchy option for 510s. : (

reviews.title: Not a 510 :/
reviews.review_text: I bought two pairs of 510s in the same order, same size, these ones and the jet black. These ones are downright baggy below the knee, not at all the advertised skinny fit. The fit is completely different from the black pair. Much looser in the butt, thigh, and lower legs, and a higher ride on the waist. Frustrating, you know? How would the same fit, same size, be so drastically different?

reviews.title: Very bad fit
reviews.review_text: I used to get 510s and they were great. However Levi's changed their patterns, for some reason, but kept the 510 name. Today, the 510s are baggy and super, super stiff even with repeated washings. I don't know why Levis felt the need to make yet another pair of ill-fitting baggy jeans when the 510 Super Skinnys were filled a need in the market place that no one else did, but they really need to go back to the super skinnys.

reviews.title: nice fit but not true to size, get a size up
reviews.review_text: These jeans have very little stretch. I usually get 28x30 and had to go for a 29x30.

reviews.title: What happened
reviews.review_text: Bring back the old original 510 cut. This was a terrible change.

reviews.title: baggy crotch
reviews.review_text: the jeans fit well but let down by baggy front area what happened to the old fit

reviews.title: terrible website
reviews.review_text: holes in the jeans! not mentioned in ads nor really visible in the pics!

reviews.title: Looks like cheap fabric
reviews.review_text: Not worth I have returned the product. Will try others.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.review_text: The 510 jeans I received are not “skinny” at all. Feel more like a straight fit.

reviews.title: Worst sizing consistency of any brand
reviews.review_text: I literally don't know what to write here. I am absolutely finished with buying Levi's online (which is my only option). Some 33s fit like 36s; some fit like 31s and I can't even button them. Moving to a different brand.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.review_text: The jet 510s used to be my favorite pair of jeans but i just ordered a new pair and i was way disappointed. It seems they changed them. they dont fit as tight and they're longer. I have no idea why they changed them, they used to be perfect

reviews.title: Great quality and feel, however...
reviews.review_text: I got these today and while I love the feel and quality, I'm disappointed by the fit. The waist and thighs are fine but a skinny jeans should get skinnier from the knees down to the ankles and these seem to have basically the same dimensions in regards to the aforementioned. Its almost like a skinny bootlegger jeans which isn't the look I was looking for. Please Levis, read the reviews and get it right from those actually wearing the product. I have a few pairs from a few years back and they fit much better than these new ones and I'm really bummed out about that.

reviews.title: Not the best material
reviews.review_text: These jeans are great... if you plan on carrying a lint roller with you everywhere you go, I don't have any pets and have never had an animal in my home but these jeans attract every strand of loose hair or any lint and a piece of everything you sit on,great jeans but horrible material and attracts everything

reviews.title: What happened to my jeans?Skinny people do exist.
reviews.review_text: Skinny people do exist, so a slim fitting jean like this was so important to me. The fit was just right. Now its boxy and uncomfortable and there is no shape in the legs. My Jet black 510s are so worn out I can't really wear them to work or anything anymore, now I am lost without the ability to get a new pair...

reviews.title: Jeans come with fake damage??
reviews.review_text: My jeans just arrived in the mail. There are little fake paint splatters on them and a tiny rip in the knee. Nowhere in the description of this product does it mention these features! Now that I come back and zoom in, I can barely see the little rip in the knee, but this is the only option in this color while all the other jeans in this color look fine. I didn't want to roleplay as a working class person -- I just wanted a nice pair of jeans I can wear for work. I ordered the black ones in this same style and they came just fine. Why would you put damaged jeans in with the other colors in this style instead of separating them out as a different product? Ridiculous.

I almost hate to take a star away because of my fat behind... but they jeans didn't fit me, so I had to give it a knock of one star... but I'm not sure they were meant to fit me; but I am pretty skinny (6' 2" and 169 lbs). So just a word to the wise... when Levis says "Super Skinny", they mean super skinny. I would have needed a shoe horn or a good friend to get these jeans on. reviews.title: Not as good as the old material...

I still don't know if I like how this new material feels, which is never a good thing. I would advise the company to make these the way they used to.

reviews.title: Terrible Sizing
reviews.review_text: I have a pair of these at home, the same style: 510, the same cotton percent, and the same elastane percent, and the same width, and height. However, when I tried these on they fit completely different; they were at least 2 sizes too small. How is it that two pairs of jeans that are the same on paper except for the color, can fit completely different? And I can't even exchange them because I ordered them online. I'm tired of having to solve a mathematical equation trying to guess my size.

reviews.title: Disappointed overall
reviews.review_text: These pants are one of the most uncomfortable pairs I've ever owned. The look and quality are great, but the fit isn't super great for the size I ordered (after the first one was awful), and the material has no stretch or give to it. It literally feels like I'm wearing pants made of wood or something, I've never owned a pair of pants so stiff and uncomfortable. Pretty let down after returning to Levi's after a bad previous experience five or so years ago, and before that I had worn them religiously for ten years or so. Probably won't be buying another pair of Levi's for years to come.

reviews.title: Redesigned!!! Not As Skinny!!!
reviews.review_text: I'm 6'0", 32x30, and I've been wearing 510's religiously for the past 2 years+. But when I ordered a new pair in Jet last week, I noticed some elements had been redesigned (for the worse, IMO). There was a weird bunching of material around the knee, and around the leg opening- more space, I assume, they're trying to give you. I was immediately skeptical. The waist seemed ok at first, but as it stretched over a few wears, it become much too large (falling off my butt, actually). I checked out the label and noticed a new material they're using. It used to be 98% cotton, 2% spandex. Now, it's 2% "elastine". Whatever. Eventually I went to a store and tried on a whole waist size lower- 31" (I've never worn this size in anything)- and discovered this was the trick for getting the true 510 fit! So...tight pants haters...rejoice, because you don't have to order a size up anymore- Levis has it built in for you! For us tight pantsed rock stars, order a size down to get the look you used to know and love!
